# C05 — Ring replay

**Depth:** light (time slider)

`GET /api/ring/{case}` builds frames from the ring cards' transactions through the shared devices / origin, in time order: which card joined when, through what, and the cumulative loss. The Containment tab plays it with a slider. Frames are built from transactions read from the graph at request time, not a stored picture.

**Attested:** Every frame names its transaction id; all ids are returned as `attested_txn_ids`.

**Numbers:** console → case → Containment & ring (generated by the run, never typed here).

**Reproduce:** `python ui/server.py`
